title: Normalized lisse realization comparison data
statement: Fix a finite-field algebraic closure and a prime $\ell$ distinct from its characteristic [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Schemes are finite type over that closure, without separatedness [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For each finite extension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], package the comparison of the intrinsic completed coefficient ring [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients] with continuous coefficients and its sheaf localization, normalized by all residue projections and the localization unit. A realization is an additive functor from raw rational constructible objects [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] to the derived category of ordinary localized-coefficient modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], identified naturally on integral objects with derived scalar extension, with its specified scalar formula on fractions. On the lisse heart [def-real-rational-lisse-heart] it is concentrated in degree zero, fully faithful, and has exactly the finite locally free sheaves as essential image. Package tensor and unit comparisons for the recorded operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], with their associativity, symmetry and unit diagrams [lem-pur-derived-pullback-tensor-iso]. Package ordinary pullback comparisons for arbitrary scheme maps, their naturality, identity and composition unit-section formulas, finite scalar comparisons with pointwise coefficient maps, composition and tensor/pullback diagrams fixed on pure tensors. Package the recorded point fibre [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] comparison with ordinary sections, and the restriction-and-coprojection transport for every point automorphism [def-real-point-automorphism-transport-construction]. Finally package the coherent finite-field family and its realization on the actual common-stage quotient [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients], fully faithful on the common-stage lisse heart [def-real-common-stage-lisse], with exactly the common-stage finite locally free modules as essential image.
